arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills now apply {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} can now be detonated early by your {c_important}Core{/c} {c_important}Judicator{/c} Skills, dealing {c_number}[SF_7*100|%|]{/c} weapon damage in a small area and gaining {c_important}Judicator{/c} Skill benefits. 

Each time you {c_important}{u}Judge{/u}{/c} an enemy, increase the damage they take from you by {c_number}[SF_5*100|%x|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[SF_5* SF_6*100|%x|]{/c} until they die.
